steps.text: Shuffle the 24 Island tiles into the island shape: a 4 x 4 square plus 2 tiles beside the 2 middle tiles of each side, small gaps between
Shuffle the Flood deck; draw 6 cards and flip those tiles to their flooded side
Shuffle the 6 Adventurer cards, 1 each; pawn on the tile showing its icon
steps.note: Starting on a flooded tile is fine

steps.text: Shuffle the Treasure deck and deal {n} cards each, faceup; replace any Waters Rise! card and shuffle it back in
Water Level marker at your chosen difficulty (Novice for a first game)
The player who last visited an island goes first; play continues to the left
